name: Hootsuite
summary: Social media management: scheduling, listening and AI content.
description: Hootsuite schedules posts across major networks, centralizes messages and measures performance. Its AI assistant OwlyWriter writes posts and captions, and listening tools track trends and brand mentions.

features_fr: OwlyWriter : posts et légendes par IA
summary_fr: Gestion des réseaux sociaux : planification, veille et contenus IA.
description_fr: Hootsuite planifie les publications sur les principaux réseaux, centralise les messages et mesure les performances. Son assistant IA, OwlyWriter, génère des posts et légendes, et la veille repère les tendances et mentions de marque.
